notes.note: Hold-in is OVER — signed 3yr/$67.5M ($75.75M max), highest-paid RB. But he strained a hamstring in practice right after and hasn't practiced since. Campbell: 'on schedule' to practice this week and play Week 1. Second soft-tissue flag of camp (back, now hammy) — Bijan is the cleaner 1.01, so from slot 3 expect Gibbs to possibly slide to you.
Zero camp flags, extension done. The clean 1.01. If Gibbs' hamstring scares the first two picks, one of them may fall to us at 3.

LEFT PRACTICE TODAY (Aug 23) with an apparent right knee injury — landed awkwardly diving for a low Cousins throw, couldn't put weight on the leg, helped off by trainers. No severity report yet. Until there's news, treat his R1 price as untouchable — do NOT pay ADP; if the room panics he's a mid-round gamble at best.

Psoas/lower-back soreness — McVay calls it precautionary, day-to-day, may not practice again until next week but 'not expected to linger'. Small discount risk at his R1/R2 price; not a fade, but have a pivot ready if it resurfaces.

Hasn't practiced since Aug 10 with vague muscle 'tightness'. Rapoport says injury is real but minor; Shanahan claims he'd practice if it were the regular season. Age + injury history + two weeks of no practice at ADP ~10 — if he's there at the 2.10/3.03 turn, size it as a discount play only.
Rejoined LIVE team drills mid-August — major milestone in the ACL comeback, trending up from the earlier back tweak. ADP (27) still prices the risk; sim likes him in R3 and the news now supports it.

Quad resolved — back in full 11-on-11s since Aug 15 including the Titans joint practice. And with Ricky Pearsall out for the season, the SF target tree consolidates around him. Sim's favorite R4 pick from early slots is back on the menu.
OUT FOR THE SEASON — PCL surgery. Remove from the board entirely. Bumps Evans/Kittle/Cowing targets in SF.
OUT FOR THE SEASON — tore his ACL in the Raiders joint practice (Aug 18). Remove from the board. Consolidates Houston targets on Nico Collins and friends.

Still on PUP from the January Achilles, though now running routes and catching in side/individual work. Week 1 (Australia) remains his stated goal, but early-week absence risk is real at 32. Sim still prefers LaPorta R6 / Kelce R8 — let someone else pay ADP 97.
PUP is an ACL — typical timeline puts his debut in October at the earliest. Full fade now, not just a wait-and-see.
Cleared to practice ~7 months post ACL/LCL surgery; camp focus is workload, not availability. Stock rising, but the sim still never targets him — Dak/Purdy/Nix tier is free 4 rounds later.
Cardinals rookie RB1 sprained his ankle (high-ankle) in the Raiders preseason game — out the rest of preseason, Week 1 vs LAC uncertain. Only draft at a discount and expect a slow start.
Groin strain — out for the whole preseason but mild per reports, on track for Week 1 with low re-injury risk. Fine as a late pick if he slips a round.
Ahead of schedule on his ACL comeback — already back in 11-on-11s and expected to play Week 1. If the room still prices him like he's hurt, he's a late-TE value.
Minor toe issue plus an illness in preseason — nothing that moves his draft price. No action needed.
#1 trending add on Sleeper earlier this month: 3yr/$35M with the Raiders, no established WR1 ahead of him, existing Kirk Cousins chemistry. Legit last-round flier for the bench.
Calf injury in 49ers camp. With Evans back and Pearsall done for the year, SF needs him — worth monitoring but the room is healthier than it was two weeks ago.
Named one of Bucs camp's biggest risers — vertical role. Deep-league watchlist only for now.
